name: Tamurahime no Mikoto
source: Tamurahime no Mikoto is a major character, being an ally to Kazuho Kimiyoshi, Miyuki Akasaka, and Nao Houtani by granting them the power to travel from 1993 to the Hinamizawa of 1983.
